text_block_list.text:
One day, with Christmas just around the 
corner, 
Daring Tact looked out the window 
and murmured softly.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...It really doesn't snow 
around here, does it?

On the flatlands of the Kanto region, 
snow in December is quite rare. 
Even if it does fall, it almost never 
accumulates.
choice_data_list:
Does your hometown get a ton of snow, 
Daring Tact?

Does your hometown get a ton of snow, 
Daring Tact?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I wonder... Actually, Hidaka has 
relatively little snowfall 
compared to Hokkaido as a whole.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
However, up in the mountains, snow can 
start falling 
as early as October...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Whenever that news arrives... Hehe, 
everyone in the neighborhood lets out a 
heavy sigh.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It is that 'Here it comes again...' 
feeling. 
Even if the total snowfall is low... 
shoveling snow can be quite grueling when 
it gets bad.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Even so... I love the snow.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The main ridge of the Hidaka Mountains 
blanketed in snow 
is truly breathtaking.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
A pure, endless white as far as the eye 
can see... 
and on clear days, it glitters in silver 
brilliance.
choice_data_list: Wow... I'd love to see that someday.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, someday... 
I would love to show it to you, Tore-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Venturing too deep into the mountains is 
dangerous, 
so just before that... yes, around the 
entrance.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Though in truth, I wish we could go 
right this moment...

That night, Daring Tact's daytime demeanor 
suddenly came to mind. 
Thinking back on her hometown, 
she had looked somehow lonely.

Back during her Junior Year, I had watched 
over Daring Tact 
struggling to adjust to the fast pace of 
the big city, 
yearning for her hometown.

If she was harboring that same loneliness 
right now... 
I wanted to do whatever I could to soothe 
it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Even so... I love the snow.

Still, as we had mentioned, it rarely 
snows around here. 
Besides, weather is inherently 
unpredictable 
and cannot be relied upon.
choice_data_list: (In that case, I'll make it snow myself!)

text_block_list.text:
So first, I sought counsel from... 
these two natives of Hokkaido.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Snow in Hokkaido, you say...? Hmm, 
now that you mention it, it's totally 
different from down here!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The snow down here is kind of slushy 
and wet... 
It gets you soaked right through, doesn't 
it?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Back in Hokkaido, you could just brush it 
off with your hand... 
So I was stunned to find out you actually 
need an umbrella!
choice_data_list:
I see... So it's a much lighter kind of 
snow.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Powder snow. 
...That's what the tourists called it.

In that case, snow made from shaved ice 
using an artificial snowmaker 
might be far too hard and rough for her 
liking.
choice_data_list:
(Should I rethink what quality to focus 
on?)

(Should I rethink what quality to focus 
on?)

text_block_list.text:
Even if it isn't real snow, even if it's 
only for a fleeting moment... 
As long as it carries that warm texture 
that makes her feel right at home, that's 
what matters.
choice_data_list:
(Decided: I'll focus on getting that 
light, fluffy texture!)

text_block_list.text:
And so, Christmas Day arrived. 
Preparations took longer than expected, 
stretching into evening.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting. 
So, where was it you wanted to go...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
A photography studio...? 
What are we doing in a place like—
choice_data_list: Try standing right there in the middle.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Eek?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Um, Tore-san...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...

What I used was theatrical paper snow. 
Prioritizing lightness, fine texture, and 
safety, 
I searched high and low for the closest 
match to powder snow.
choice_data_list:
Did I manage to make it... feel like your 
hometown snow?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, Tore-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. 
It truly feels like I have returned home.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Because—it is so warm.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, 
from the bottom of my heart...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
By the way, all of this snow... 
What shall we do with it now?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: In that case—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san, I have gathered the rest of it 
over here.
choice_data_list: Sorry for making you help clean up...
Sorry for making you help clean up...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Please, do not worry. 
...To be honest, this is wonderful fun.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it feel a bit like tidying up 
after the Twinkle Festival? 
It makes me feel just a little... like 
your classmate.♪

After that, Daring Tact told me she wanted 
to 
show her gratitude for the snow, 
and brought me out here—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Though, this magnificent view isn't 
the only gift I have for you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
A wooden flute. It was made back home, 
and I brought it along with me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
In return for the lovely snowy memories 
you gave me... 
I would like to offer you the melody of 
nature.

As Daring Tact plays her wooden flute, 
a rustic, birdlike melody rings out into 
the night sky, 
resonating with the gentle murmurs of the 
quiet lake.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —...Phew.
choice_data_list:
That was amazing, Daring Tact! I'm deeply 
moved!

That was amazing, Daring Tact! I'm deeply 
moved!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... 
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Knowing you're always willing to share 
your feelings 
with me so directly... has truly saved me 
time and again.
choice_data_list: Honestly, that was the least I could do...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't say that! You have no idea 
how much strength it gave me...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Being the eldest of five sisters, 
I've always had to play the dependable big 
sister at home...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you give me your approval, 
Tore-san, 
it always makes me feel... just a little 
bit like a little sister.
choice_data_list:
If I'm going to be your big brother, I'll 
need to act a lot more dignified!

If I'm going to be your big sister, I'll 
need to act a lot more dignified!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Dignity isn't necessary. The kind 
and gentle 
Tore-san I have right now is my absolute 
greatest pride.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I almost forgot to mention it. 
Tore-san—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas! 
Please... continue to let me rely on you 
from here on out.
